name: Butterfield Foods LLC
old_description: Since 2011, our SQF 2000 Level 3 status has provided assurance that the products you buy from us have passed rigorous international standards for food safety and quality, including HACCP.
about:
Butterfield Foods LLC operates from Noblesville, Indiana, as a family-owned and operated custom food producer. The company emphasizes its family ownership and decades of culinary experience, though a specific founding year is not publicly stated.

The 60,000-square-foot facility is USDA inspected and holds SQF 2000 Level 3 and HACCP certifications, with on-site microbiological testing. Production capabilities include steam-jacketed kettles, steam and convection ovens, spiral freezer and nitrogen tunnels, high-speed sandwich lines, and hand assembly lines. The company offers recipe commercialization and nutritional analysis led by a Certified Research Chef, with a Culinary Institute of America graduate overseeing the kitchen team. Packaging options range from flexible pouches (2–8 lbs) to PET, CPET, or aluminum trays (10 oz–5 lbs) with modified atmosphere packaging.

Butterfield serves as a co-manufacturing partner for brands seeking custom assembly of gluten-free, halal, and kosher products such as burritos, quesadillas, sandwiches, and retail entrees. Its customer base includes food companies looking for a co-packer that can handle product development through commercial production.

The company differentiates itself through a culture of food safety and culinary integrity, targeting 100% on-time delivery and defect-free shipments. Management highlights the advantage of a medium-sized organization where clients can directly access ownership, and the R&D team works with customers at every stage from conception to execution.
